en.title: Chrome Hazard: Ghost Ship of the Rainy City
en.premise: In a back‑alley trash heap, I found a “Nameless Cat.” Embedded in its neck was forbidden data belonging to the megacorporation that rules the city. That data is the key to activating the legendary “Flying Ship” and tearing through the sky of this controlled society.

zh.title: 铬危机：雨城的幽灵飞船
zh.premise: 在巷弄的垃圾堆里，我捡到了一只‘无名猫’。它脖子里植入的是统治城市的巨型企业的禁忌数据。那数据正是启动传说中的‘飞行船’，撕裂这座管控社会天空的钥匙。
